space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 5
space.notes: env_layout2 plus one coffee machine, coffee_machine_0, for the end-state variant of scenario_20 (scenario_50, F47/F47b): after its last delivery the human walks to the machine for a coffee break and stays there instead of idling at the kitting table, so the robot's last table deliveries are not refused by the separation stop. The machine lies due east of the table (bearing 0 deg), >= 51 deg off every shelf bearing from the table (shelf_2 -51, shelf_7 -59, shelf_3 -107, shelf_4 -121, shelf_6 -128). Unlike env_layout2 the hypothesis space carries coffee_break(coffee_machine_0) (foreseeable, both priors). Everything else is env_layout2 byte for byte.

env_objects.notes: Shared delivery sink. A candidate whose carry walk reaches the table while the human's projection is still running converges here, and its min_dist is set by the projected arrival-time gap (both placements coincide at this point when the gap is under a tick). Candidates arriving after the human's projection ends show no sink conflict. Current figures: analysis/t1_conflict_measurement/REPORT.md, TODO-28/TODO-30.

Robot's cheapest task (approach 447 + carry 583 cm ≈ 54 ticks at 20 cm/tick, incl. pick and place). Its conflict comes from the matched arrival time at the kitting table, not from the 150 cm adjacency to shelf_3; the adjacency makes item_4 an early IR decoy.
Human's first target. Human approach 449 vs robot 447 — time-aligned. With assignment_prior off, theta crosses at the human's grasp here (step 22).

Robot's clean alternative (approach 550 + carry 820 cm ≈ 71 ticks). Seen from the human's path it lies nearly behind shelf_3 (9–20° off heading), so it is the IR decoy that keeps confidence below theta until the grasp (TODO-38).
Robot's third task (approach 1151 + carry 875 cm ≈ 103 ticks). Far enough east that it never competes — present to keep the pool at three, matching scenario_00.
Human's second target. At -36.9 deg from the human's start it is angularly far from shelf_3/4/6, so it does not muddy the early ambiguity.
Landmark (T-C1): a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls.

The human's end-state spot (scenario_50): coffee_break(coffee_machine_0) after its last delivery, PT60S, then it idles here. 470 cm east of the table's arrival point, off every robot route (T->shelf_7 leaves the table at -59 deg; the robot passes 340+ cm from here). A real coffee machine (F47b: a scheduled task's bound object must carry the schema's type), so coffee_break(coffee_machine_0) is a live hypothesis for the whole run, which scenario_20 has not.
